issue.title: RefsPanelModelTests.testPanelVisibilityChangeFiresWhenShownAndHidden sees duplicate hide notifications
issue.description: Repo: bob-mac-capture. Proposing bead: bob-cli-a8 landing audit. CI line 27 expects two visibility callbacks after controller.show() and controller.hide(), but receives three. Introduced with the Highlights Command-T entry changes 785508c before the first a8 commit. RefsPanelController.hide calls panel.orderOut and then onVisibilityChange; makePanelIfNeeded installs onResignKey -> hide, so hiding a key panel reenters hide and publishes another callback. Make hide visibility publication idempotent/reentrancy-safe while preserving model/card cleanup and the Highlights takeover registration. Add or retain narrow regression coverage. This failure appears in pre-epic CI 39499997621, e99cec6 CI 39505351980, and current CI 39511067813. No semantic duplicate among 7h/8j or causal active epic. Small: the call chain and duplicate publication are identifiable in source. Assess the AppKit reentrancy in a Mac test rather than merely changing the expected count.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Identical failure on three consecutive observed states: pre-epic 785508c (run 39499997621), e99cec6 (39505351980), and 1d5735a (39511067813). No passing rerun observed.

issue.creation_reason: Landing bob-cli-a8 revealed a repeatable pre-existing macOS CI failure that is not covered by the existing node-specific task scopes. Track it separately so the epic does not absorb unrelated baseline work.
